vendor.blurb: Musk's lab: monthly Grok on value, top-tier Imagine, text flagship half a step back

grok-4-7.tagline: A fast coding gun at a fraction of the price
highlights: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 46 (xhigh), up from Grok 4.6's 44
Terminal-Bench 4.0 jumps from 20.3% on 4.6 to 38.0%
Code Arena #13 (1629), 94% on the Next.js eval, 2–7x cheaper
Now on Bedrock, the full GitHub Copilot lineup and Grok Build
grok-4-7.notes: Reasoning levels: low/medium/high/xhigh; a Grok 4.7 Fast also exists at 2x the price. Output tokens are 125% higher than 4.6; 44 bypasses found in a SWE-Together audit were rerun. Community verdicts are split.

grok-4-6.tagline: The default engine of Grok Build 1.0
highlights: Code Arena #17 (1621), just 8 points behind 4.7
AA Intelligence Index 44 (high), at about half of 4.7's cost per task
Agent Arena median cost per task $0.74, net gain +1.22%
Text Arena 1453, actually above 4.7
grok-4-6.notes: Reasoning levels: low/medium/high/xhigh. Focused on long-horizon agents and coding; an external tier list puts it in A, above 4.7.

grok-4-5.tagline: The first Grok co-trained with Cursor
highlights: First Grok co-trained on real developer interactions from Cursor
Code Arena 1552 (#33), Text Arena 1465 (#47)
Agent Arena median cost per task just $0.43
grok-4-5.notes: At launch it claimed #4 on the AA index (old index methodology); replaced by 4.6/4.7 two months later.

highlights: Input price down about 40% from its predecessor, output just $2.5/M
First with native video input; can generate PDFs, spreadsheets and slides directly
Text Arena 1442 (#89), Code Arena 1357 (#101)
grok-4-3.notes: Went to SuperGrok Heavy testers on 4/17, then to the full API on 4/30.

highlights: Three API variants: reasoning, non-reasoning and multi-agent
Text Arena 1475 (#34), still the Grok family's best text score
Code Arena only 1374 (#93), clearly behind on coding
grok-4-20.notes: The current API version is 0309; chat reception was better than the later coding-focused versions.

grok-build-0-1.tagline: A terminal coding model at 100 tokens a second
highlights: Trained specifically for agentic coding, 100+ tokens/sec output
Powers an early version of Grok Build, the open-source (Apache 2.0) terminal agent
Succeeds 2025's Grok Code Fast 1 (Code Arena just 1167)
grok-build-0-1.notes: Public beta on the API; from Grok Build 1.0 the default switched to Grok 4.6/4.7. No independent leaderboard results.

grok-imagine-image-2.tagline: The runner-up artist, beaten only by GPT Image
highlights: #4 on AA text-to-image (Elo 1154), behind only three GPT Image models
Arena Text-to-Image #6 (1301); claimed #2 in both text-to-image and editing at launch
Magic-wand local edits, segmentation, background removal, and up to 5 reference images
grok-imagine-image-2.notes: Called Quality Mode inside Grok. AA lists $60 per 1K images; the official API docs say $0.04 per image.

grok-imagine-image.tagline: The two-cent baseline Grok image model
highlights: Quality version is #17 on AA text-to-image (Elo 1046, 2026-05)
Arena Text-to-Image: base #23 (1170), pro #26 (1162)
$0.02 per image, the cheapest in the Imagine family
grok-imagine-image.notes: Merges the 1.x variants (grok-imagine-image, -quality, -pro and others); the exact launch date is unverified.

grok-imagine-video-1-5.tagline: The Grok video model you can actually direct
highlights: Arena Text-to-Video #4 (agent version 1492), right behind Gemini Omni
AA Image-to-Video #8 (Elo 1099) at $8.4/minute
Images can be set as first, middle or last frame, loop, or reference
grok-imagine-video-1-5.notes: Launched in early June for 720p image-to-video; in July it added text-to-video and reference-to-video and native 1080p. 1.5 is not in the AA text-to-video top 20.

grok-imagine-video.tagline: The original that topped AA video in January
highlights: Topped both AA text-to-video and image-to-video in January 2026
Now #13 on AA image-to-video (1072) and #23 on text-to-video (1065)
$4.2/minute with audio, still the cheapest tier
grok-imagine-video.notes: Replaced by 1.5 but still available on the API.
